prompt: Create a high-fidelity UI concept board for AniRec, an anime recommendation web app, using the attached real PySide screenshots as visual authority. Output a landscape 2-by-2 board of FOUR actual desktop app viewports: top-left MY LIBRARY, top-right PROFILE, bottom-left COMPARE, bottom-right SETTINGS. Each viewport should have its own compact indexed left navigation rail and enough usable content to judge its layout. No perspective, no device frames, no marketing poster, no floating decoration. Highest practical resolution, legible large-enough text. References contribute green-black surfaces, bone text, brass personal signals, aqua secondary/community signals, compact monospaced headings and readable prose, thin borders and square panels. Preserve these precisely, but do NOT copy the original page geometry. Background #070C09, panels #0C1410, text #C6D4C2, brass #D9A441, aqua #5FBFB5. Keep clear rectangular focus/selection treatments and quiet surfaces without neon glow. Every viewport must visibly say SAMPLE DATA / LAYOUT CONCEPT. Shared rail: ANIREC, 01 Discover, 02 My Library, 03 Profile, 04 Compare, 05 Settings; highlight the correct tab. No invented capability claims, no recommendations advertised as watched history. Use initials poster placeholders as the real reference does, not fake anime artwork. Specific content: Library is saved recommendation decisions, Watch later and Not interested; show 3 illustrative saved titles Monster, Death Note, Steins;Gate, explicitly a sample layout. Profile is anirec_sample, completed 312, mean score 7.42; taste overlap 72%, rating bias -0.43, contrarian 31%; evidence Kotoura-san YOU 9 / COMMUNITY 6.7, Gakkougurashi! YOU 9 / COMMUNITY 7.4. Compare is anirec_sample with NeoBalls_, overlap 78%, shared 96, both rated 74; ratings Evangelion YOU 9 / FRIEND 3, One Piece YOU 4 / FRIEND 9, Spirited Away YOU 10 / FRIEND 6. Settings has Recommendation, Appearance, Account and Local data; adventurousness familiar-to-surprising, batch size 10, default sort Personal match, show covers, account not connected. Do not show authentication tokens or fake successful sync. Prioritize the structure described next over the reference layout. DIRECTION C: LIBRARY-LED WORKSPACE. The dominant structure is title-led editorial shelves, with compact evidence attached to each title and distinct hierarchy. Library: a brief Watch later heading with count 3, then three handsome medium-size poster-format initials cards MN, DN, SG with titles and Personal match/MAL scores; a quiet Not interested tab. Profile: small identity summary and a restrained metric strip, then broad title-led evidence panels Kotoura-san and Gakkougurashi! with initial tiles and paired YOU/COMMUNITY ratings, organized under Your strongest disagreements. Compare: a compact 78% overlap ribbon, then a row of three poster-format initials cards for Evangelion, One Piece, Spirited Away with instantly readable paired YOU/FRIEND scores under each; section title Where you differ. Settings: no anime posters here; a practical two-column modular form with Recommendation and Appearance as main sections, Account and Local data lower down, plain help and clear buttons. More content-first and browseable than the matrix or inspector approaches; preserve the original instrument-panel seriousness and avoid cinema hero banners, gradients, rounded pill buttons, glossy cards or generic entertainment streaming styling.
